topic: 地点、方向与正在发生的事
grammarFocus: there is / are；地点介词；现在进行时；祈使句入门。
title: At the New City Library
instructions: 这是原创模拟练习材料，不是官方考试。请先读短文，再回答8个问题。单选题请选一个最合适的答案；填空题请用短文中的原词，不要超过字数限制。所有答案都能在短文中找到直接依据。
passage:
A: This is the new city library. It is big and quiet. There is a desk near the door. A woman is sitting there. She is a helper.

B: Look at the sign on the wall. It says, "Be quiet, please." There are many books on the shelves. Two boys are reading at a table. A cat is sleeping under the table.

C: The computer room is on the left. Go down the hall and turn right. The toilet is next to the stairs. Please do not eat in the library. Please put your bag here, near the desk.

questions.explanation: 短文第一句说这是新的城市图书馆，所以选“在城市里，是新的”。
questions.evidence: This is the new city library.

questions.explanation: 短文说门附近有一张桌子（There is a desk near the door）。
questions.evidence: There is a desk near the door.

questions.explanation: 短文说那个女人坐在那里（A woman is sitting there）。
牌子上的字是“Be quiet, please.”，意思是请安静。
短文说两个男孩在桌子旁读书（Two boys are reading at a table）。
questions.evidence: Two boys are reading at a table.

questions.prompt: 猫在桌子下面做什么？请填一个动词。
questions.explanation: 短文说猫在桌子下面睡觉，动词是sleeping。
questions.evidence: A cat is sleeping under the table.

questions.explanation: 短文说电脑房在左边（The computer room is on the left）。
questions.evidence: The computer room is on the left.

questions.prompt: 短文请人们把包放在哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文最后说请把包放在这里，靠近桌子（near the desk）。
questions.evidence: Please put your bag here, near the desk.

vocabulary.example: This is the new city library.
There is a desk near the door.
Look at the sign on the wall.
There are many books on the shelves.
A cat is sleeping under the table.
The toilet is next to the stairs.

grammar.title: There is / are 与现在进行时
grammar.explanation: 我们用 there is 说“有一个”，用 there are 说“有多个”。现在进行时表示“正在做某事”，结构是 am/is/are + 动词ing。祈使句用来请别人做或不做某事，比如 Please be quiet. 和 Please do not eat.
grammar.example: There are many books on the shelves.

options: There is a desk near the door.
There are a desk near the door.
There is many books on the shelves.
answers: There is a desk near the door.
questions.explanation: a desk 是单数，用 there is。
questions.evidence: There is a desk near the door.

options: There are many books on the shelves.
There is many books on the shelves.
There are a cat under the table.
answers: There are many books on the shelves.
questions.explanation: many books 是复数，用 there are。
questions.evidence: There are many books on the shelves.

options: Two boys are reading at a table.
Two boys is reading at a table.
Two boys reading at a table.
answers: Two boys are reading at a table.
questions.explanation: Two boys 是复数，现在进行时用 are + reading。
questions.evidence: Two boys are reading at a table.

options: Please do not eat in the library.
Please not eat in the library.
Please do not eating in the library.
answers: Please do not eat in the library.
questions.explanation: 祈使句的否定形式是 Please do not + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: Please do not eat in the library.

part1: Is there a library near your home?
Please tell me one thing you do not do in a library.
speaking.part2: Describe a quiet place you know. You should say:
part3: Is your place big or small?
Who is there in your place?
Please say one rule in your place.

transfer.writing: 写3到5个简单句，介绍你附近的一个地方。用 there is / there are 说有什么，用现在进行时说人们正在做什么，用 Please 写一条规则。
